The `DISTRIBUTION=arch` setting is likely used by the upstream build system to tailor configuration for Arch Linux. No post-install hooks or systemd service installations are present in this PKGBUILD, which is acceptable since those would be handled by the main `apparmor` package. Overall, the PKGBUILD follows AUR packaging best practices and shows no signs of malicious behavior.
